name: Easy-to-use Learning Management System focused on driving business results for customers
description:
We are a SaaS Learning Management System catering both to organizations looking to train their staff and to organizations that sell courses b2b.

Our product is user-friendly. It’s designed to keep administration for our customers simple, while delivering an easy-to-use training experience for their users. It’s easy to get started, allowing customers to quickly get value from our platform.

For us training is not an end in itself but a tool to drive business value. Through our automation we remove a lot of the day to day management of training. Letting our customers focus on their core business instead of managing their users and training programs.

Let’s use a retail chain as an example of how we this creates value for our customers:

1. A new hire joins a store, and their details are added to the company’s Workforce Management System.
2. Through an integration the user is automatically created in our LMS, complete with details such as their store location, role, and other relevant information.
3. Based on this user information, we automatically assign the appropriate training for their role or store, and send them invitations to get started.
4. We remind the user to complete their training if they are lagging behind.
5. The user is also added to their manager's team when they are created. Letting the manager see how their employees are progressing in real time, and if they need to act in any way in order to get the training completed. 

All the customer needs to do is create the training in the first place and set the rules for who should take it. From there, our platform takes care of everything else, including follow-ups and detailed reporting.

All user progress is recorded and available through general reports or for more in depth enquiries. By linking training data with other business metrics, our customers can identify areas for improvement, optimize performance, and drive key business KPIs while ensuring compliance.

For our customers selling courses the value is different, but the way there is similar. 

They get to deliver a great training experience to their customers. With invitations, reminders, certificates of completion together with real time progress reports with minimal effort through our automation. They can focus on their sales while we handle delivery.

name: SAAS Business for Automated Token Generation
description:
This business is an automated token generator that requires little admin or technical knowledge to run. It supports all EVM blockchain networks like Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, Polygon, and more. The business model requires the owner to run marketing, and revenue is automatically sent to your wallet.

The business offers 3 dApps, each with 6 pricing plans. Users can create tokens with prices ranging from $10 to $750, depending on the plan they choose. Everything is handled automatically.
shortDescription: SAAS Business for Automated Token Generation
businessModel:
The business has three main sources of revenue: Google Adsense and sponsored posts, commission fees from token transactions, and custom token generation.

- Commission fees from token transactions: Coincode earns commission fees from every token transaction that occurs on its platform, regardless of the blockchain network. The fee is calculated based on the token's value, the transaction's complexity, and the network's congestion. The fee is deducted from the user's balance and transferred to Coincode's wallet.

- Custom token generation: Coincode offers a service to users who want to create their own tokens with custom features and specifications, such as name, symbol, decimals, supply, and functions. We charge a flat fee for this service, which is paid upfront by the user. Coincode then manually creates and deploys the token on the desired network, and transfers the ownership to the user.

- Google Adsense and sponsored posts: We displays ads from Google Adsense on its website, and earns revenue based on the number of impressions and clicks. We also offer sponsored posts to token creators who want to promote their tokens on its blog and social media channels, and charges them
a fixed fee per post.(not active)See more
techStack:
Website is custom designed and developed by myself, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Website is also responsive and mobile-friendly, and it adapts to different screen sizes and devices. Web dApp is built on Node.js, which is a platform that allows me to create and run the web app’s back-end using JavaScript. Node.js is fast, scalable, and efficient, and it enables me to handle the web app’s logic and functionality.

Web dApp uses Web3.js, which is a plug-in that allows me to interact with the blockchain networks and the smart contracts using JavaScript. Web3.js is a library that provides me with the tools and methods to create and manage the tokens and the transactions on the web app.

Web dApp also uses Solidity, which is a language that allows me to write and deploy the smart contracts on the blockchain networks. Solidity is a high-level and object-oriented language that follows the syntax and logic of JavaScript. The smart contracts are the core of the web app, as they define and execute the token features and functions.See more

businessModel:
Reentras operates under a multi-layered revenue model designed for both primary ticket sales and secure secondary resale:

1. Service Fee on Primary Ticket Sales

When producers sell tickets through the platform, the buyer pays a service fee (generally around 15% of the ticket price).

A portion is retained by Reentras as revenue.

Another portion can be shared with the event producer.
This model mirrors the industry standard for ticketing platforms.

2. Commission on Official Resale

Reentras enables secure resale with QR regeneration.

Buyers and sellers pay a small commission per transaction.

After covering payment gateway costs, Reentras retains a net margin per resale ticket.
This creates ongoing revenue even after the primary sale is sold out.

3. Payment Processing Margin (Wallet / Balance System)

Users can load credit (wallet) to complete purchases.

Reentras charges a fixed small margin on top-up operations to cover processing fees and generate profit.

Withdrawals for sellers are handled manually, with no custody of electronic money.

4. Enterprise Agreements with Event Producers

Producers can use the platform end-to-end for ticketing, validation, resale, dashboards, and settlement tools.
The platform charges:

A service fee per ticket sold

Optional additional fees for premium features
This creates a scalable B2B revenue channel.See more
